added_failures_note: base-gate.log at 2fd5d5b58 reports 18 passed, 0 failed, EXIT=0; head-gate.log at e67ba8f0 reports 19 passed, 0 failed, EXIT=0; no failure id appears in either arm, so the difference is empty. The only commit after the head gate is 168a5c632, which touches docs and figures only.

findings.text: the new test re-derives the separatrix with rebuild_frame_separatrix and asserts only that the distances it computes are finite, so a regression that stops redraw_persisted_bank writing symmetric_rms_distance_m or symmetric_sup_distance_m into the receipt, or that writes a wrong value there, leaves the suite green while the done-when receipt clause is the substance of the deliverable.

rebuild_frame_separatrix calls display_flux_module._branches, a private function of nova/equilibrium/display_flux.py, so a rename or signature change by the node that owns that module breaks the redraw path at runtime rather than at review time; the public owner build_display_flux_map exposes no standalone assembly entry point and this node was fenced out of that file.

the tests line carries the literal placeholder <worktree> and the manifest has no baseline_suite or after_suite block, so the gate command a promotion receipt is filled from is a template and the two arms survive only in the logs' own # command: headers.

justifications.durability: negative-control-256.log reddens tests/test_diiid_forward_gs_match.py:462 at assert drawn with EXIT=1 when display_flux._branches is pinned to 256 slots, which is the assembler regression the test exists to catch.

justifications.fit: the change uses the nova.media poloidal_axes, draw_flux_contours, draw_wall and draw_nulls vocabulary and adds no plan, issue or version label to any name, but benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1992 reaches into display_flux_module._branches, a private symbol of a module another node owns.

justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 2fd5d5b58 168a5c632 touches only benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py, the two declared test files, docs/figures/diiid-forward-onboarding/forward-gs-2026-11/ and the declared fragment.
